WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)::INTEGER AS year,
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS total_consumption
    FROM
        "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN
        "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        c."currency" = 'EUR'
        AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)::INTEGER IN (2012, 2013)
        AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY
        c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)::INTEGER
),
segment_growth AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2012 THEN total_consumption ELSE NULL END) AS consumption_2012,
        MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2013 THEN total_consumption ELSE NULL END) AS consumption_2013
    FROM
        yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY
        "segment"
),
percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        (consumption_2013 - consumption_2012) AS increase_decrease,
        CASE
            WHEN consumption_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE ((consumption_2013 - consumption_2012)::FLOAT / consumption_2012) * 100
        END AS percentage_increase
    FROM
        segment_growth
)
SELECT
    "segment",
    percentage_increase
FROM
    percentage_change
WHERE
    percentage_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 1

UNION ALL

SELECT
    "segment",
    percentage_increase
FROM
    percentage_change
WHERE
    percentage_increase IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY
    percentage_increase ASC NULLS FIRST
LIMIT 1;

WITH customer_2012 AS (
    SELECT
        t."customerid"
    FROM
        "transactions_1k" t
    WHERE
        t."date" = '2012-08-25'
        AND t."price" = 634.8
    LIMIT 1
),
consumption_data AS (
    SELECT
        y1."consumption" AS consumption_2012,
        y2."consumption" AS consumption_2013
    FROM
        "yearmonth" y1
    JOIN
        "yearmonth" y2 ON y1."customerid" = y2."customerid"
    JOIN
        customer_2012 c ON y1."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE
        y1."date" LIKE '2012%'
        AND y2."date" LIKE '2013%'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN consumption_2012 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (consumption_2012 - consumption_2013) / consumption_2012
    END AS consumption_decrease_rate
FROM
    consumption_data;
